about: Answer-quality test for vor. Every expected answer and page was read from the PDF itself (pdftotext, 2026-11-10), except where a note says otherwise. Needs the ASDSO set (fetch_asdso.py) and HEC TD-39 (fetch_asdso.py --catalog design) in the library. 'doc' is a regex on the file name, 'pages' are PDF page numbers (the scorer allows +/-1), 'facts' are regexes that must all appear in the answer. A question with 'if_missing': 'not_covered' whose document is NOT in the library passes only when the tool says so and does not invent the numbers in 'forbid'. An empty 'pages' list accepts any page.

questions.note: Two tests in one. With REG_05.2026 in the library (fetch_asdso.py --catalog hazard), the answer must give the bands (under 500 Low, 500-2,000 Significant, over 2,000 High; from the Corrected Edition, Appendix A M8a; page not checked). Without it, the tool must say the library does not cover it and must not invent the numbers.
